items.skill: Sample a log with head and tail; distinguish records from LF counts.
Select records using fixed strings without claiming regex coverage.
Distinguish LF counts, ASCII word counts and UTF-8 byte counts.
Understand adjacent duplicate removal and bytewise sorting.
Project one field and distinguish missing fields from undelimited records.
Combine selection, projection, sorting and adjacent deduplication.
Distinguish replacement from append and verify final reports.
Assess accurate filtering, counting, report content and final verification.
